title: AgentSDLC Verification Evidence Schema
description: Schema for machine-verifiable evidence produced during verification or task completion

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this verification evidence record

gate_id.description: Name of the quality gate evaluated (e.g. spec, contract, code, test, security, ai)

target_artifact.description: Feature ID or artifact path evaluated (e.g. 001-ai-task-copilot, contracts/openapi.yaml)

evaluator.description: Agent or harness executing the check (e.g. Test Agent, eval-runner.js, linter)

command_executed.description: Exact terminal command used to produce this evidence

raw_logs.description: Snippets or digest of terminal logs proving evaluation
